description_en: Initiates an outbound call when the agent is online
description_zh: 当座席在线时，通过此接口进行呼叫
name: CloudPreviewoutcall

parameters.help_en:
The call center ID.

Before calling this operation, create a call center instance in the Cloud Contact Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access URL
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心 id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The agent ID. The value is a 3- to 10-digit number
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The phone number of the customer to call. Include the area code for landline numbers. Do not add 0 before mobile numbers. When number masking is enabled, you can obtain the customerNumberKey value from the screen pop event to make the outbound call. For more information, see [Encrypted outbound call](../字段定义/接口部分/加密外呼号码加密规则.md). If the number is encrypted, URL-encode it before passing it in. When the outbound call configuration for extension number dialing is enabled, this field supports the format of mobile number-extension number
parameters.help_zh: 需要进行呼叫的客户方电话号码，固话带区号，手机不加0。 当开启号码隐藏设置时，可从弹屏事件中获取customerNumberKey的值，进行外呼；[加密外呼](../字段定义/接口部分/加密外呼号码加密规则.md)；如果是加密的号码，需要URLEncode后传入；当外呼相关配置-支持分机号外呼开启后，此字段可支持传手机号-分机号格式
parameters.name: tel

parameters.help_en: The timeout period on the agent side, in seconds. Valid values: 5 to 60. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫座席侧超时时间；取值范围 5<=timeout<=60，默认30(单位:s)
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The timeout period on the customer side, in seconds. Valid values: 5 to 60. Default value: 45
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫客户侧超时时间；取值范围 5<=dialTelTimeout<=60，默认45(单位:s)
parameters.name: dial_tel_timeout

parameters.help_en: The channel variables. Channel variables can be used in the following scenarios: 1. Event push: used as push fields. 2. Call records: stored in custom fields. 3. SIP-Header: passed to the downstream link of the call through SIP-Header. Format example: [{"name":"mainUniqueId","value":"cdr_main_unique_id","type":"2"},{"name":"callType","value":"cdr_call_type","type":"2"}]. name: the variable name. value: the variable value. type: the variable type. Valid values: 1: common variable. 2: PJSIP_HEADER variable (used to pass variables to the customer side through SIP-Header. A maximum of five variables are supported)
parameters.help_zh: 通道变量可以在以下场景中使用：1. 事件推送，作为推送字段使用2. 通话记录中，将字段存储在自定义字段3. 通过SIP-Header方式将字段传到呼叫的下游链路格式如: [{"name":"mainUniqueId","value":"cdr_main_unique_id","type":"2"},{"name":"callType","value":"cdr_call_type","type":"2"}]name：变量名称value：变量值type：变量类型，1.普通变量 2.PJSIP_HEADER变量（用于将变量通过SIP-Header方式传到客户侧，最多支持5个）
parameters.name: call_variables

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the request. If no value is passed in, the system generates one automatically. If the value is encrypted, URL-encode it before passing it in
parameters.help_zh: 请求唯一id；取值：如果没有传入值则系统会生产。如果是加密的号码，需要URLEncode后传入
parameters.name: request_unique_id

parameters.help_en: The backup outbound numbers. When the primary number (Tel) fails to connect, the backup numbers are called. A maximum of five numbers are supported. Separate multiple numbers with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 备用外呼号码；tel没呼通时呼叫备用号码，最多支持5个号码，多个之间用逗号分隔
parameters.name: backup_tels

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to conduct a satisfaction survey. Valid values: 0: Do not conduct a satisfaction survey. 1: Conduct a satisfaction survey. Default value: the enterprise configuration
parameters.help_zh: 是否满意度调查；0.不进行满意度调查 1.进行满意度调查，默认：取企业配置
parameters.name: is_investigation

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcription on the call recording. Valid values: 0: Do not perform. 1: Perform. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 此次通话录音是否进行ASR转写；0.不进行 1.进行 默认：1
parameters.name: cdr_is_asr

parameters.help_en: The enterprise trunk number or the preconfigured caller ID number displayed to the customer
parameters.help_zh: 可传入企业中继号码或设置好的客户侧外显号码
parameters.name: ob_clid

parameters.help_en: The specified caller ID area code. Pass in an area code to display a caller ID number under the specified area code. If both ObClid and ObClidAreaCode are specified, ObClid takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 指定外显区号；传入区号，在指定区号下外显号码；如果obClid和obClidAreaCode都传的情况下，按照obClid外显
parameters.name: ob_clid_area_code

parameters.help_en: The caller ID number group displayed to the customer. To use ClidGroup, the account must support identifier-based routing. When this parameter is specified, the Clid parameter is ignored
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧外显号码组；使用clidGroup需要账号支持按标识路由，使用此参数时clid参数无效
parameters.name: ob_clid_group

parameters.help_en: The collection of caller ID numbers. Format example: [{"clid":"1708587xxxx","priority":1},{"clid":"1304412xxxx","priority":2},{"clid":"0107990xxxx","priority":3}]. clid: the caller ID number (String type, required). priority: the priority (Integer type, optional). Note: A maximum of 10 numbers can be specified per call. If a priority is specified for any number, all numbers must have a priority specified
parameters.help_zh: 外显号码集合, 格式如: [{"clid":"1708587xxxx","priority":1},{"clid":"1304412xxxx","priority":2},{"clid":"0107990xxxx","priority":3}] clid：外显号码（String类型）（必填）priority：优先级（Integer类型）（非必填） 特别说明： 一次呼叫最多允许传10个指定号码；若指定了号码优先级，要求所有传入的号码都必传
parameters.name: clid_list

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Code.description_en:
The request status code.
OK indicates that the request was successful.
For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
